name: Goli Baje
steps: Whisk yogurt with a little measured water. Mix in both flours and salt, beating into a thick smooth batter.
Cover and rest the batter in a warm spot until lightly tangy and bubbly; this coastal version relies on this rest for its soft interior.
Fold in coconut, chilli, ginger and curry leaves without knocking all the air out. Add only enough remaining water if the batter is too stiff.
Heat oil over medium heat. Drop small rounded portions and fry slowly, turning as they puff into irregular golden balls.
Drain and serve fresh with coconut chutney; the crust is lightly crisp and the middle fluffy.
tips: A thick, rested batter gives goli baje its characteristic tang and airy texture.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
